lines: Ugh, the radar's fuzzing out again. I can't read a single dot.
The radar swears there's a dot behind us. I don't believe it.
Come on, relay, just light up for once. Please. I'm begging you.
I love this thing, but the radar lies to me every single time.
Hey, don't trust the little blip on the map. It's been wrong all night.
Okay, the relay's lit. Nice work, everybody. Now let's get moving.
I'm so tired my legs are shaking, and the radar's still jumping around.
Radar blinked out again, so you're flying blind for a bit, sorry!
Ha, that relay sparked like a birthday candle. Nobody's touching it again.
I swear that relay has a grudge against me personally.
My hands are still buzzing from the last one. Give me a second.
Don't be scared. Okay, be a little scared. Then keep walking with me.
This minimap's useless when it flickers. Just follow my voice, okay?
I know the radar's broken, but it's been right about the stairs.
Lights out, radar gone, and I can't find my own feet right now.
That relay humming again? Yeah, I don't like that one bit.
Thank you, radar, for showing up right when I stopped breathing.
You owe me a snack for this, and I'm not joking about it.
Honestly the relay room smells like burnt toast. Hurry up, please.
Got the route open, finally. My thumb is going numb though.
Radar's blinking green. That's the first nice thing it's done all day.
Stop staring at the map and look at me when I'm talking.
I don't trust the radar, but I trust you, so lead the way.
Ugh, the relay cable's frayed again. Who keeps yanking on it?
I counted six blips, then the radar decided to be dramatic.
Hey, when the lights flicker, stay close. I hate walking alone.
The radar's wrong about the left hall, I checked it with my own eyes.
I made it through the static, barely, and my hair is standing up.
Alright, no more fiddling with the relay. Tell me when it's safe.
Honestly, I'd rather fight a wall than fix that relay again.
My flashlight's dying and the radar's dying too. Great team we are.
Why does the relay always pick the worst moment to blink out?
Hey, I'm scared too. Grab my sleeve and we'll go together.
Trust me, the relay's fine. Mostly fine. Probably fine. Let's go.
We made it to the lift! Gah, I'm crying a little, don't look.
The radar's chirping like it's excited about something terrible.
I'd trade my last granola bar for a cold drink right now.
Relay's sparking again. I'm going to pretend I didn't see that.
Radar says we're clear, which means something is definitely not clear.
You're doing great, seriously. Keep the pace and don't look back.
I'm proud of us. The relay lit up on the first try!
It took three tries, but the relay finally agreed to light up.
Please stop poking the radar, it's the only map we have left.
Five presses, and my thumb is gonna fall off. Somebody spot me.
The radar pinged something behind the door, and I'm not checking.
Look, I'm not saying the radar's haunted, but it's haunted.
It's dark, it's cold, and that stupid relay keeps blinking at me.
Hey, you still with me? Say something so I know you're there.
Radar's back, and guess what? A dot right on top of us. Lovely.
Stay put a sec. I need to breathe before the next relay.
Man, I miss when the radar just showed the map and nothing else.
My shoulder's wrecked from hauling that bag, so don't mind me.
I dropped the cold can in the water. Now I'm mad about it.
Your jokes are awful, but I laughed, so don't get cocky.
The relay's humming happily, which is exactly what worries me.
Not brave, just tired and wobbly, so you'll have to drag me.
Okay, the relay stopped flickering. My heart can start again.
Who left the relay door open? Close it, it's freezing in here.
Yeah, the radar's a liar. But it's our liar, so we keep it.
Sure, I'm trusting the map again, and I hate that I am.
You get the next relay. I'll hold the light and not fall over.
Ugh, the radar froze and now I'm stuck staring at a blank map.
Let's get the radar fixed later. Right now, just get me out.
I'm so happy you're here, even if you're slow on the stairs.
The radar's the only thing I can't stand, and I'd still miss it.
I'm holding my breath, don't talk to me until the lift moves.
We're gonna be fine. I say that, and I mean it, mostly.
Dude, that relay almost took my eyebrow off. Be more careful.
I'm not mad at you. I'm mad at the relay. Different thing.
Honest question: how many presses does this thing need now?
Fine, you were right about the radar. Don't make it weird.
I'm so sorry about the blackout. It was my fault, I jiggled the cable.
Cold hands, sore back, bad radar. Could be worse, I guess.
The relay sparked, and my heart did a little flip. Not cool.
Okay, the relay finally lit. Let's not talk about how long it took.
